verdict.rationale: ElevenLabs documents a visual workflow builder for multi-step workflows, and agents can be managed through the dashboard, so the core no-code visual flow design is claimed. The evidence is one thin overview line, though, and it never mentions branching logic, state management, or agent/human handoffs. missing for 10: documented branching/conditional routing, explicit states or nodes, handoff/transfer support in the builder, in-depth builder docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can design multi-step conversation flows in a visual builder with branching, states, and handoffs without writing code

citations.quote: Build multi-step workflows with visual workflow builder
ElevenLabs Agents are managed either through the ElevenAgents dashboard
